title: Product UI Engeneer
description:
**Role Overview**  
Join our dynamic team as a Product UI Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in designing and building engaging web interfaces. As part of our team in Cochin, you'll work in an ONSITE environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to engineer innovative solutions for large-scale applications while ensuring the highest standards of UI/UX excellence.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop robust, high-performance web user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks.
* Collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers to translate Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD prototypes into seamless user experiences.
* Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and accessibility.
* Maintain and continually improve UI codebases using version control best practices (e.g., Git).
* Participate in code reviews, architectural planning, and technical decision-making.
* Champion UI/UX design principles and work to ensure consistency across products.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues to improve overall application quality.
* Stay current with new front-end technologies and trends to ensure product innovation.

**Must have requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience as a UI Engineer or in a similar role.
* Strong expertise in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frameworks such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Advanced understanding of UI/UX design principles and best practices.
* Demonstrated experience building large-scale web applications.
* Proficient in code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work full-time onsite in Cochin, Kerala.

**Nice to have requirements**

* Experience with design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
* Familiarity with animation libraries and front-end testing frameworks.
* Working knowledge of backend integration (RESTful APIs, GraphQL).
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG, ARIA).

**Perks and Benefits**

* Be part of an international group with merit-based growth opportunities.
* Unlock your potential to innovate and create industry-leading solutions.
* Collaborative and creative environment focused on continuous learning.

title: Interior Designer
description:
Industry: Interior Design / Interior Fit-Out

Location: Ayyappankavu, Kochi

Experience: Minimum 8+ Years

Job Type: Full-time | Work From Office

Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Interior Design or Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch)

Job Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced and creative Senior Interior Designer to lead the design and execution of residential and commercial interior projects.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in space planning, concept development, material selection, technical drawings, client presentations and project coordination. The role requires someone who can independently manage projects from initial design concepts to final execution while ensuring design quality, functionality and client satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Design Development: Lead the complete interior design process, including concept creation, space planning, layouts, mood boards and detailed design development.

Client Management: Understand client requirements, present design concepts, incorporate feedback and manage design approvals.

Technical Drawings: Prepare and review detailed working drawings, furniture layouts, elevations, electrical layouts, ceiling plans and execution drawings.

3D Visualisation: Oversee 3D designs and renderings to ensure accuracy and alignment with approved concepts.

Material Selection: Recommend suitable materials, finishes, furniture, lighting, hardware and accessories based on project requirements and budgets.

Project Coordination: Work closely with production teams, site supervisors, contractors and vendors to ensure accurate execution of approved designs.

Site Visits: Conduct site inspections, verify measurements, resolve design-related issues and monitor execution quality.

Team Leadership: Guide and mentor junior designers, review drawings and ensure timely completion of design deliverables.

Budget & Timeline Management: Ensure designs are practical, cost-effective and aligned with project budgets and delivery schedules.

Quality Assurance: Maintain design standards and ensure the final output meets client expectations.

Candidate Requirements

Minimum 8+ years of experience in interior design, architecture or interior fit-out projects.

Degree/Diploma in Interior Design or B.Arch qualification.

Strong experience in residential and commercial interior projects.

Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp and relevant 3D design/rendering software such as 3ds Max, V-Ray, Lumion or Enscape.

Excellent knowledge of modular kitchens, wardrobes, custom furniture, materials, finishes and interior detailing.

Ability to independently handle design concepts, client presentations, working drawings and execution coordination.

Strong understanding of site measurements, construction details, production drawings and installation requirements.

Experience in leading and mentoring a team of interior designers.

Excellent creativity, communication, presentation and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Candidate

An experienced Senior Interior Designer or Architect with a strong portfolio of completed interior projects, excellent technical design knowledge and the ability to independently lead design teams and coordinate projects from concept to completion.

Candidates with a background in interior design firms, modular interior companies or turnkey interior fit-out projects will be preferred.

title: Graphic Designer & UI/UX Designer
description:
Senior Graphic Designer / UI/UX Designer

**Company:** LADR Media LLP **Location:** Kochi, Kerala (work from office) **Type:** Full time **Timings:** 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM, flexible and output based **Reports to:** Founder **Salary:** 25k-40k per month, based on skill and portfolio

**About us**

LADR Media is a performance marketing agency based in Kochi. We run ads, build content, and grow brands across India, Dubai, and Australia. We also build our own software products and run Laptop Clinic, a laptop and printer repair chain with 10 branches across Kerala.

Design is not decoration here. Every static ad we make gets tested against a cost per lead. Every brand identity we build has to work on a shopfront, a phone screen, and an invoice. If your design does not perform, it does not ship.

**About this role**

Right now the founder is the last set of eyes on every design and every video that leaves this agency. That does not scale.

We are looking for someone to take that over. You will own the creative standard at LADR Media. Everything that goes out, static ads, videos, brand identities, decks, app screens, passes through you first. You set the bar and you hold the team to it.

This is a senior role. You will still design every day, but you will also direct, review, and build the systems that keep quality high as we grow.

**What you will do**

**Own creative quality**

* Review and approve all design and video output before it reaches a client
* Give clear, specific feedback to the video editor and junior designers, not just "make it better"
* Build design systems, templates, and brand books so quality does not depend on one person
* Keep a written creative standard the whole team works from

**Performance creative**

* Design high converting static ads for Meta and Google
* Produce ad creative in batches so we can test angles, hooks, and offers properly
* Work with the performance marketing team, look at the numbers, and learn what actually converts
* Kill what does not work and double down on what does

**Brand identity**

* Build brand identities from scratch, including logos, colour systems, typography, and usage guidelines
* Rebrand and clean up existing client identities
* Design for offline too, including signage, shop branding, packaging, and print for our other brands too.

**UI and UX**

* Design app and web interfaces for our in house software products and client websites
* Work closely with our web developer and software developers, hand off clean Figma files, and stay involved through build
* Build and maintain component libraries and design systems
* Think through user flows, not just screens

**Ideas and direction**

* Come up with campaign concepts, not just execute briefs handed to you
* Research what is trending globally and in each client's category
* Build and maintain a reference library and swipe file the whole team can pull from
* Bring proactive ideas to client meetings and internal reviews

**Client facing work**

* Design pitch decks, proposals, and client reports that look as good as the work inside them
* Present and defend creative decisions to clients in plain language

**What you must have**

* A portfolio that speaks for itself. Show us brand identities, ad creative, and UI work. Depth matters more than volume.
* 4 or more years in design, with at least some of it in an agency or fast paced environment
* Real command of Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign
* Proven ad creative work. Show us statics you designed and, if you have them, the results.
* Strong typography and layout skills. This is where most designers get exposed.
* Understanding of colour theory, hierarchy, spacing, and grids
* UI and UX fundamentals, including responsive design, accessibility basics, and handoff to developers
* The ability to explain why a design works, not just say that it looks good
* Good spoken and written English. You will brief people and present to clients.
* Speed. Agency work moves fast and volume is part of the job.

**Nice to have**

* Motion design in After Effects, even at a basic level
* Video editing knowledge so you can direct our editor properly
* Experience leading or reviewing other designers
* Comfort with AI image and design tools to speed up ideation
* 3D or product mockup skills
* Webflow, Framer, or basic front end awareness

**Who this role is for**

You have taste and you can explain it. You notice when kerning is off, when a hierarchy is fighting itself, when an ad looks pretty but says nothing. You keep up with design and advertising globally, and you have a folder of work you admire and reasons why.

You want ownership. You are tired of just executing other people's briefs and you want to set the direction.

You are not the right fit if you need a reference to copy for every job, if you get defensive about feedback, or if you cannot give feedback to others without being either vague or rude.

**Our hiring process**

Three rounds. We keep it short and practical.

**Round 1: Telephone interview** A short call to understand your background and what you are looking for. We will go through your portfolio and ask you to walk us through two or three projects, including your thinking, not just the final file.

**Round 2: Paid practical test** We give you a real brief. Expect a mix of an ad creative task and either a brand or UI task, so we can see your range. This round is paid, because your time and skill have value before you join us. We judge you on craft, on how well you solved the actual problem, and on how you present your thinking.

**Round 3: Final selection round** A conversation with the founder and the team. We talk about the test, how you work, how you give and take feedback, and how you would run creative here. Salary and start date get discussed in this round.

**What you get**

* Ownership of the creative function at a growing agency
* Work across marketing, brand, product, and retail, so your portfolio gets real range
* Real clients across India, Dubai, and Australia
* Good gear, software access, and AI tools
* A direct line to the founder
* Room to grow into a Creative Director role as the team grows
* A team that values honest work and getting things done

**How to apply**

Send us the following:

* Your CV
* A link to your portfolio (Behance, Dribbble, personal site, or a clean PDF)
* One line on the project you are most proud of and what problem it solved

Applications without a portfolio link will not be reviewed.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Share your Portfolio link:
* One line on which work in your portfolio you are most proud of and why. (attach the link and reason):

Experience:

* Graphic design: 4 years (Required)

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Eloit**

Eloit Innovations is a fast\-growing Global SaaS / Software Product company building cutting\-edge solutions in education and faith\-based technologies. Eloit is on a mission to unlock potential through graceful innovation. Our flagship platforms include Edisapp School ERP, Credisapp, Kristapp, BibleOn, and more, headquartered in London, with over a decade of innovation and operations in Kochi, India.

**Job Overview:**

We are looking for a talented and creative UI Developer with a strong eye for design and a passion for building intuitive, engaging, and user\-friendly digital experiences across web and mobile platforms.

The ideal candidate will combine strong UI/UX design skills with hands\-on frontend development expertise, particularly in Vue.js, to transform user and business requirements into high\-quality digital products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop intuitive, responsive, and visually engaging user interfaces for web and mobile applications.
* Translate business and user requirements into user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
* Develop user\-facing applications and reusable UI components using Vue.js.
* Create and maintain design systems, style guides, UI patterns, and reusable design components to ensure consistency across products.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Convert functional requirements and user needs into simple, effective, and aesthetically appealing user experiences.
* Identify, analyse, and resolve UI/UX usability issues through research, testing, and iterative design.
* Create original visual assets, graphics, icons, and other UI elements when required.
* Ensure designs are responsive, accessible, scalable, and optimized for different screen sizes and devices.
* Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs and maintain visual consistency between design and production.
* Conduct design reviews and provide guidance on UI/UX best practices.
* Maintain clear documentation of design decisions, workflows, components, and interaction patterns.
* Stay updated with emerging UI/UX trends, frontend technologies, accessibility standards, and design methodologies.

Design and develop UI flows, menus, HUDs, and user\-facing applications that meet defined design goals; create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and supporting documentation; translate business and user requirements into style guides, design systems, design patterns, and attractive, consistent user interfaces; develop and maintain responsive user\-facing applications using Vue.js; create original graphic designs and visual assets where required; and identify, analyse, and troubleshoot UX and usability problems through iterative design and testing.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* Required Skills \& Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Design, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in UI development, UI/UX design, frontend development, or a related role.
* Strong proficiency in modern UI/UX design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience with Vue.js and modern frontend development practices.
* Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, responsive design, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Good understanding of user\-centered design principles, information architecture, interaction design, and usability.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, design systems, and reusable UI components.
* Strong understanding of responsive web and mobile design principles.
* Ability to translate designs into functional, production\-ready interfaces.
* Strong visual design skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Good problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks.
* Knowledge of REST APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services.
* Experience with mobile UI/UX design and mobile\-first design principles.
* Understanding of accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive design.
* Experience working with design tokens and component libraries.
* Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience in designing products for education, ERP, SaaS, or enterprise applications.

**What We Value**

* A strong user\-first mindset.
* Creativity combined with practical problem\-solving.
* Ability to balance design quality, usability, and technical feasibility.
* Ownership of projects from concept through implementation.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and experiment with new technologies and design approaches.

**Why Eloit?**

At Eloit, you will not just be doing a job; you will be part of a mission. We build technology that impacts thousands of schools, students, and faith communities across the globe, and every person on our team plays a real role in that story.

We are a decade\-old, London\-headquartered Global SaaS / Software Product company with a passionate team in Kochi, India, building world\-class platforms trusted by 700\+ institutions across 4 continents. We move fast, we build things that matter, and we invest in the people who make it happen.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Health Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Day Shift
* Values\-driven and mission\-oriented work culture
